reserveReview.rationale: Pinned to the newest independently examined period: MCCPA's opinion (in both the May and June files) covers May 31, 2026 - $6,241,593 cash and cash equivalents (70.9532%) and $2,555,167 US government-backed debt (29.0468%) equal to 8,796,760 SBC issued (zero surplus). The June file's page-2 management assertion (June 30: cash $7,909,476 / govt debt $1,372,461 vs 9,281,937 SBC) is unexamined - MCCPA also discloses it relied on company-provided records without independent confirmation. Composition review intentionally NOT anchored on the June assertion.
